evidence_rule: Every level above 0 must include an exact quote from the CV. No quote = 0.

A.name: Operational proximity to freight
A.question: Did they do logistics operations work with their own hands?

levels.4: 2+ years in a hands-on ops role at a freight forwarder, CHA, NVOCC, port or 3PL (documentation, customs, carrier allocation, exception handling)
levels.3: Under 2 years hands-on ops, OR 2+ years as a PM/engineer embedded directly with forwarder ops teams
levels.2: Built or sold logistics software with regular direct contact with ops users
levels.1: Adjacent only: supply chain in e-commerce/manufacturing, or logistics APIs integrated from the outside

B.name: Built the fix unasked
B.question: Did they see a broken process and fix it without a mandate?

levels.4: Self-initiated a tool or process that others adopted, with scale stated
levels.3: Self-initiated, adopted by own team, scale not stated
levels.2: Improved something within an assigned remit

C.name: Ownership without a layer
C.question: Did they own outcomes with nobody above or around to catch it?

levels.4: Sole owner of a product/area/book with nobody between them and the customer or outcome (e.g. sole PM, no layer, reports to CEO/founder)
levels.3: Owned a scope end to end with light oversight
levels.2: Owned features inside a larger team structure

role_notes.SPM: Level 4 = sole or first PM at a company, or owned an area with no senior PM layer above, reporting to a founder/CEO

D.name: Judgment and learning loops
D.question: Do they kill, post-mortem, and write down why?

levels.4: Killed or reversed their own work on evidence AND documented why (post-mortem, kill note)
levels.3: Wrote a post-mortem or root-cause analysis that changed team practice
levels.2: Data-informed decisions; no kill or loss documented

E.name: Product craft for the role
E.question: Can they discover, prioritise and ship at the level this role needs?

PM.4: Owned a product area; shipped 3+ features with measured outcomes; runs discovery directly with users; has shipped and killed things
PM.3: Shipped with outcomes; discovery thin or indirect
PM.2: Translated user needs into specs or builds without a PM title

SPM.4: Owned an integration/platform/data layer (carrier systems, port portals, ERP, FMS, APIs); made build-vs-configure-vs-don't-touch calls; set up product practices others adopted
SPM.3: Owned a complex product area with integrations, but not the platform layer or practice-setting
SPM.2: Shipped features as a PM; limited platform or integration exposure

F.name: Composure in live operations
F.question: Did they deliver in a real-time crisis?

levels.4: Named incident handled personally under time pressure with a clean outcome
levels.3: On-call, escalation or outage ownership with a stated outcome
levels.2: Worked in time-critical operations; no incident described

bands.label: Partial match
bands.suggestion: Shortlist if no flags; probe A and B

flags.consider_for_pm: role == SPM and spm_score < 55 and pm_score >= 75
flags.experience_below_jd: PM: < 2 yrs PM-type ownership; SPM: < 5 yrs. Info only, never a reject reason
flags.parse_failed: CV could not be read; route to Arjun unscored

note: No band or flag ever sends an email. Arjun's click is the only trigger.
